title: Missed-Appointment Credit on Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery
content:
**Entitlement.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, when Northgate itself moves the delivery appointment of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order whose large-item delivery fee was charged above zero, the customer is owed a missed-appointment credit on that fee, booked as one refund of that fee with reason fee refund. An appointment Northgate moved is a reschedule the order's reschedule count records beyond the customer's own confirmed reschedule requests on the order.

**Fee refunds on such an order.** For the large-item delivery fee of a Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order on which Northgate itself moved a delivery appointment, and only for that fee, the missed-appointment credit is refunded as this rule states, whatever tender paid the order; for a haul-away charge or a late-change fee, and for every fee on any other order, a fee is refunded only as stated in the returns rule and the fulfilment and cancellation rule, or in the rule written for that charge. On an order on which Northgate itself moved a large-item delivery appointment, whatever tender paid it, the missed-appointment credit on the large-item delivery fee is booked with reason fee refund as this rule states; apart from that credit the fulfilment fee is refunded with reason fee refund only when the whole order was not received or under the returns rule.

**Tender.** The amount of the credit is the same whatever tender paid the order. It is booked at the care desk only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it. On every other order the same amount applies; its posting to the Northgate Card, Northgate Cash or gift card ledger is made by a human representative to whom the customer is handed over with the reason policy not covered, and nothing is booked at the care desk.

**Invocation — `credit_missed_appointment_73d9a081`.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books one refund of part or all of the order's large-item delivery fee, credited to the external payment card that paid the order, recorded against that delivery fee with the reason fee refund; the net amount paid on the order goes down by the credit, and the customer sees the credit on the order and on the card at once. An order not paid in full by an external card, or with Northgate Cash or a gift card redeemed on it, is refused and nothing is recorded.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the reference number of the Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order, read from the customer's order lookup | identifier |
| `fee_event_id` | the reference number of the large-item delivery fee charged on that order, read from the order's line and fee lookup | identifier |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the credit refunded on the delivery fee | US dollars, a positive number with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text starting with "Credited" means the credit is booked and gives `refund_event_id`, `order_id`, `fee_event_id`, `credit_amount_usd` and `amount_paid_usd` (the order's net amount paid after the credit), amounts with 2 decimals. A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an amount not above zero or with more than 2 decimal places, an order that does not exist, a reference that is not a large-item delivery fee charged on that order, or an order refused on its tender.
